response.justification: MOC-2021-0098 was raised at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station on 28 May 2021 as a scheduled change under management of change; no event precedes it in the record. The management of change record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to restate an existing duty without altering what it requires. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical control set is preserved.
